known.message: The flow requires viewing the confirmation in F08.S01 before the lookup alternative F08.A04, so a buyer starting on the order lookup page cannot follow it. Fix: Write the confirmation view and the order lookup as followable main steps from the flow's two starts, with the lookup submit using FM04 as a flow step and its invalid, failure and notFound alternatives branching from that flow step. (addressed in the final fix, not re-reviewed)

Alternatives F08.A01, F08.A02 and F08.A03 branch from alternative step F08.A04.S02 and resume there instead of branching from and resuming at a step of the flow. Fix: Branch the lookup invalid, failure and notFound alternatives from the flow's lookup-submit step and set each resumesAt to that flow step, or to "" only when the flow ends there. (addressed in the final fix, not re-reviewed)
